cases.description: Subtract a constant indicator (value 5) from the close‑price indicator of a series with close prices [10,20,30]. The resulting indicator should yield [10‑5, 20‑5, 30‑5] = [5,15,25].
Subtract a negative constant (-3) from the same close‑price indicator. Expected values are [10‑(-3), 20‑(-3), 30‑(-3)] = [13,23,33].
Calling minus(null) should throw NullPointerException because the method does not accept a null Indicator.
Subtracting an indicator that belongs to a different BarSeries than the current NumericIndicator should raise IllegalArgumentException (series mismatch).

If the supplied Indicator returns null for a value at a given index, the resulting NumericIndicator will attempt to perform a subtraction on a null Num, leading to NullPointerException when the value is accessed.
